    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">[最优化技术] 3-9 共轭梯度法</span>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202610/3633603-20261020234229286-358185472.png" alt="[最优化技术] 3-9 共轭梯度法" class="desc_img">
        共轭梯度法是共轭方向法里最常用的一种。它用相邻两点的梯度差代替海塞矩阵，在新点的负梯度方向上作一次修正，就得到与上一步共轭的新方向，既保留维数步收敛的性质，又不必计算和存储海塞矩阵。本文从共轭方向与梯度的关系讲起，推出共轭系数的表达式，给出迭代步骤与程序框图，并用二元二次函数完整算两步，附可运行的 C++ 程序。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1><center>3-9 共轭梯度法</center></h1>
<h2 id="共轭梯度法">共轭梯度法</h2>
<h3 id="简述">简述</h3>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>上一篇介绍了共轭方向法。它用平行搜索构造共轭方向：从两个点出发沿同一方向各搜索一次，把两个一维极小点连起来，就得到与搜索方向共轭的新方向。这个方法只需要函数值，但每构造一个新方向都要作两次一维搜索；要用它系统地得到 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个共轭方向，还得配合方向替换。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>上一篇末尾已经埋下伏笔：二次函数的梯度差满足 <span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) - \nabla f(X^{(k)}) = H(X^{(k+1)} - X^{(k)})\)</span>，所以共轭条件里的矩阵 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 可以用相邻两点的梯度差代替。只要利用迭代点处的梯度，就能直接递推出共轭方向，既不必计算 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span>，也不必为了构造一个方向去作两次平行搜索。这就是<strong>共轭梯度法</strong>（Conjugate Gradient Method）。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>共轭梯度法是共轭方向法中的一种，因为它的每个共轭向量都依赖于迭代点处的负梯度构造出来。它的第一个搜索方向取初始点的负梯度方向，这就是最速下降法；以后各步的搜索方向是把负梯度偏转一个角度，相当于对负梯度作了修正。所以共轭梯度法实质上是对最速下降法的改进，又称<strong>旋转梯度法</strong>。</p>
<h3 id="共轭方向与梯度的关系">共轭方向与梯度的关系</h3>
<p>考虑正定二次函数</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(X) = \frac{1}{2}X^T H X + B^T X + C
\]</div><p></p><p>在点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(k)}\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)}\)</span> 处的梯度分别为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(k)}) = HX^{(k)} + B, \qquad \nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) = HX^{(k+1)} + B
\]</div><p></p><p>两式相减，得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) - \nabla f(X^{(k)}) = H\left(X^{(k+1)} - X^{(k)}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>若 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)}\)</span> 是从 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(k)}\)</span> 沿 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 作一维搜索得到的，则 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)} - X^{(k)} = \alpha^{(k)}S^{(k)}\)</span>，上式写成</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) - \nabla f(X^{(k)}) = \alpha^{(k)} H S^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p>用前面已经得到的某个共轭方向 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(j)}\ (j &lt; k)\)</span> 左乘上式：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[[S^{(j)}]^T\left[\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) - \nabla f(X^{(k)})\right] = \alpha^{(k)}[S^{(j)}]^T H S^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p>而 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(j)}\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 共轭，右端为零，于是</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[[S^{(j)}]^T\left[\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) - \nabla f(X^{(k)})\right] = 0
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>这就是共轭方向与梯度之间的关系：相邻两点的梯度差，与所有已用的共轭方向都正交。反过来，只要梯度差与 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(j)}\)</span> 正交，由于 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(k)} \ne 0\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(S^{(j)}\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 必然关于 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 共轭，两者是等价的。另一方面，<span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)}\)</span> 是沿 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 的一维极小点，所以 <span class="math inline">\([S^{(k)}]^T\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) = 0\)</span>。两条合起来，共轭条件可以完全用梯度表达，<span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 不必出现——这正是共轭梯度法能够只靠梯度构造方向的原因。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>图 4-10 画出了这个关系：<span class="math inline">\(g_k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(g_{k+1}\)</span> 分别是 <span class="math inline">\(X^k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(X^{k+1}\)</span> 处的梯度，<span class="math inline">\(g_{k+1} - g_k\)</span> 垂直于已有的共轭方向 <span class="math inline">\(d^j\)</span>，而 <span class="math inline">\(g_{k+1}\)</span> 又垂直于本次搜索方向 <span class="math inline">\(d^k\)</span>。</p>
<div style="text-align: center">
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202610/3633603-20261020233452726-1819283807.jpg" alt="共轭梯度法的几何说明" style="zoom: 60%">
</div>
<blockquote>
<p>符号说明：图中 <span class="math inline">\(x^k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(x^{k+1}\)</span> 即正文的 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(k)}\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(X^{(k+1)}\)</span>；<span class="math inline">\(g_k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(g_{k+1}\)</span> 即 <span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k+1)})\)</span>；<span class="math inline">\(d^j\)</span> 是已得到的共轭方向 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(j)}\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(d^k\)</span> 是本次的搜索方向 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="递推公式">递推公式</h3>
<p>既然共轭条件可以用梯度差表达，就可以在负梯度方向上作一次修正，构造出与上一个方向共轭的新方向。取</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[S^{(k+1)} = -\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) + \beta^{(k)} S^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p>即在新点的负梯度上，沿上一步的搜索方向偏转一个由 <span class="math inline">\(\beta^{(k)}\)</span> 控制的份额。系数 <span class="math inline">\(\beta^{(k)}\)</span> 由共轭条件 <span class="math inline">\([S^{(k+1)}]^T H S^{(k)} = 0\)</span> 确定。</p>
<p>先看第一步。记 <span class="math inline">\(g_0 = \nabla f(X^{(0)})\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(g_1 = \nabla f(X^{(1)})\)</span>，此时 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(0)} = -g_0\)</span>。由</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[g_1 - g_0 = \alpha^{(0)} H S^{(0)}
\]</div><p></p><p>把 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(1)} = -g_1 + \beta^{(0)}S^{(0)}\)</span> 代入共轭条件，得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[[S^{(1)}]^T H S^{(0)} = \frac{1}{\alpha^{(0)}}\left[-g_1 + \beta^{(0)}S^{(0)}\right]^T\left(g_1 - g_0\right) = 0
\]</div><p></p><p>展开，注意 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(0)} = -g_0\)</span>，且 <span class="math inline">\(g_1\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(0)}\)</span> 正交（一维搜索），因而 <span class="math inline">\(g_1\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(g_0\)</span> 也正交，于是</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[-\|g_1\|^2 + \beta^{(0)}\|g_0\|^2 = 0
\]</div><p></p><p>即</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\beta^{(0)} = \frac{\|g_1\|^2}{\|g_0\|^2} = \frac{\|\nabla f(X^{(1)})\|^2}{\|\nabla f(X^{(0)})\|^2}
\]</div><p></p><p>对第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 步重复同样的过程，得到一般的递推式</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\beta^{(k)} = \frac{\|\nabla f(X^{(k+1)})\|^2}{\|\nabla f(X^{(k)})\|^2}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[S^{(k+1)} = -\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) + \beta^{(k)}S^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>这个系数只用相邻两点的梯度模，不涉及 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span>，也不涉及任何矩阵运算。这就是共轭梯度法与一般共轭方向法的区别：方向仍然关于 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 共轭，但构造过程只用到梯度。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span><strong>注意</strong>：有的资料把第二项写成 <span class="math inline">\(-\beta^{(k)}\nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span>。由于第一步 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(0)} = -\nabla f(X^{(0)})\)</span>，两种写法在第一步完全一致；但递推时被继承下来的是上一步的搜索方向，所以一般写成 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="具体步骤">具体步骤</h3>
<p>对于给定初始点 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)}\)</span> 和收敛精度 <span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon\)</span>：</p>
<p>① 令 <span class="math inline">\(k = 0\)</span>；</p>
<p>② 取初始点的负梯度方向为第一个搜索方向</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[S^{(0)} = -\nabla f(X^{(0)})
\]</div><p></p><p>③ 沿 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 作一维搜索，求最优步长 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(k)}\)</span>，使</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(X^{(k)} + \alpha^{(k)}S^{(k)}) = \min_{\alpha} f(X^{(k)} + \alpha S^{(k)})
\]</div><p></p><p>并令</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X^{(k+1)} = X^{(k)} + \alpha^{(k)}S^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p>④ 若 <span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f(X^{(k+1)})\| &lt; \varepsilon\)</span>，则停止，输出 <span class="math inline">\(X^* = X^{(k+1)}\)</span>；否则转⑤；</p>
<p>⑤ 若 <span class="math inline">\(k = n\)</span>，则令 <span class="math inline">\(X^{(0)} = X^{(k+1)}\)</span>，转②重新取负梯度方向（重置）；否则转⑥；</p>
<p>⑥ 计算</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\beta^{(k)} = \frac{\|\nabla f(X^{(k+1)})\|^2}{\|\nabla f(X^{(k)})\|^2}, \qquad
S^{(k+1)} = -\nabla f(X^{(k+1)}) + \beta^{(k)}S^{(k)}
\]</div><p></p><p>令 <span class="math inline">\(k = k + 1\)</span>，转③。</p>
<p><strong>符号说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(X^{(k)}\)</span> 是第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 次迭代点，也是第 <span class="math inline">\(k-1\)</span> 次搜索的终点；</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 是第 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 个搜索方向，<span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个方向关于 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 两两共轭；</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(k)}\)</span> 是沿 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span> 的最优步长，<span class="math inline">\(\beta^{(k)}\)</span> 是构造下一个方向的共轭系数。</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>第⑤步对二次函数来说通常不会走到：<span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个共轭方向用完，<span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 元二次函数已经到达极小点。它的作用在非二次函数上——此时 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 次搜索后共轭性已经被函数的非二次项破坏，继续沿用旧方向没有意义，不如重新从负梯度出发，重新积累一组共轭方向。</p>
<h3 id="程序框图">程序框图</h3>
<div style="text-align: center">
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633603/202610/3633603-20261020233456489-1058682689.jpg" alt="共轭梯度法的程序框图" style="zoom: 50%">
</div>
<blockquote>
<p>符号说明：图中 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(d^k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(g_k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\alpha_k\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\beta_k\)</span> 分别对应正文的 <span class="math inline">\(X\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(S^{(k)}\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(k)}\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(\beta^{(k)}\)</span>；判据为 <span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f(X^{(k+1)})\| &lt; \varepsilon\)</span>；“<span class="math inline">\(k = n\)</span>”框即第⑤步的重置，重置后回到取 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(0)} = -\nabla f(X^{(0)})\)</span> 的框。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="实例计算">实例计算</h3>
<p>仍用前面几篇的标准函数，完整地算两步。</p>
<h4 id="题目">题目</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(X) = x_1^2 + 2x_2^2 - 4x_1 - 2x_1x_2,\quad X^{(0)} = [1,1]^T,\quad \varepsilon = 0.01
\]</div><p></p><p>它的梯度和 Hessian矩阵为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X) = \begin{bmatrix} 2x_1 - 2x_2 - 4 \\ 4x_2 - 2x_1 \end{bmatrix},\qquad
H = \begin{bmatrix} 2 &amp; -2 \\ -2 &amp; 4 \end{bmatrix},\qquad
B = \begin{bmatrix} -4 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p>理论最优解为 <span class="math inline">\(X^* = [4,2]^T\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(f(X^*) = -8\)</span>。</p>
<h4 id="解答">解答</h4>
<p><strong>1. 第一次搜索</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(0)}) = \begin{bmatrix} 2 - 2 - 4 \\ 4 - 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -4 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix},\qquad
S^{(0)} = -\nabla f(X^{(0)}) = \begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ -2 \end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p>沿 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(0)}\)</span> 搜索，此时 <span class="math inline">\(X = [1+4\alpha,\ 1-2\alpha]^T\)</span>，</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\varphi(\alpha) &amp;= (1+4\alpha)^2 + 2(1-2\alpha)^2 - 4(1+4\alpha) - 2(1+4\alpha)(1-2\alpha) \\
&amp;= 40\alpha^2 - 20\alpha - 3
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>令 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi'(\alpha) = 80\alpha - 20 = 0\)</span>，得 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(0)} = 0.25\)</span>，所以</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X^{(1)} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} + 0.25\begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ -2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 0.5 \end{bmatrix},\qquad f(X^{(1)}) = -5.5
\]</div><p></p><p>该点的梯度为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(1)}) = \begin{bmatrix} 4 - 1 - 4 \\ 2 - 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 \\ -2 \end{bmatrix},\qquad
\|\nabla f(X^{(1)})\| = \sqrt{(-1)^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{5} \approx 2.236 &gt; 0.01
\]</div><p></p><p>未达精度，继续。</p>
<p><strong>2. 构造共轭方向</strong></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\beta^{(0)} = \frac{\|\nabla f(X^{(1)})\|^2}{\|\nabla f(X^{(0)})\|^2} = \frac{(-1)^2 + (-2)^2}{(-4)^2 + 2^2} = \frac{5}{20} = 0.25
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[S^{(1)} = -\nabla f(X^{(1)}) + \beta^{(0)}S^{(0)} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix} + 0.25\begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ -2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 1.5 \end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p>验算共轭性：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[H S^{(1)} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 &amp; -2 \\ -2 &amp; 4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 1.5 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix},\qquad
[S^{(0)}]^T H S^{(1)} = [4,-2]\begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix} = 0
\]</div><p></p><p>确实共轭。</p>
<p><strong>3. 第二次搜索</strong></p>
<p>沿 <span class="math inline">\(S^{(1)}\)</span> 搜索，此时 <span class="math inline">\(X = [2+2\alpha,\ 0.5+1.5\alpha]^T\)</span>，</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\varphi(\alpha) &amp;= (2+2\alpha)^2 + 2(0.5+1.5\alpha)^2 - 4(2+2\alpha) - 2(2+2\alpha)(0.5+1.5\alpha) \\
&amp;= 2.5\alpha^2 - 5\alpha - 5.5
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>令 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi'(\alpha) = 5\alpha - 5 = 0\)</span>，得 <span class="math inline">\(\alpha^{(1)} = 1\)</span>，所以</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[X^{(2)} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 0.5 \end{bmatrix} + 1\cdot\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 1.5 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p>此时</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\nabla f(X^{(2)}) = \begin{bmatrix} 8 - 4 - 4 \\ 8 - 8 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix},\qquad f(X^{(2)}) = -8
\]</div><p></p><p>满足 <span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f(X^{(2)})\| = 0 &lt; \varepsilon\)</span>，停止，<span class="math inline">\(X^* = [4,2]^T\)</span>。</p>
<p>把两次搜索列成表：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center">次序</th>
<th style="text-align: center">起点</th>
<th style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(\nabla f(X^{(k)})\)</span></th>
<th style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(\beta^{(k-1)}\)</span></th>

</tr>

<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\((2,0.5)\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\([-1,-2]^T\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(0.25\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\([2,1.5]^T\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(1\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\((4,2)\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(-8\)</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>两次搜索就到达精确极小点，正好是 <span class="math inline">\(n=2\)</span> 步。第一步走的是最速下降方向，如果继续沿负梯度走，就会像最速下降法那样出现锯齿；共轭梯度法在第二步把负梯度 <span class="math inline">\([1,2]^T\)</span> 偏转成 <span class="math inline">\([2,1.5]^T\)</span>，一步到位。</p>
<p>与前两篇的方法对比：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center">方法</th>
<th style="text-align: center">是否用梯度</th>
<th style="text-align: center">一维搜索次数</th>
<th style="text-align: center">结果</th>
<th style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(f\)</span></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">坐标轮换法（<span class="math inline">\(\varepsilon = 0.01\)</span>）</td>
<td style="text-align: center">否</td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(8 \times 2 = 16\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\((3.992188, 1.996094)\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(-7.999969\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">共轭方向法</td>
<td style="text-align: center">否</td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(3\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\((4,2)\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(-8\)</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">共轭梯度法</td>
<td style="text-align: center">是</td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(2\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\((4,2)\)</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span class="math inline">\(-8\)</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="代码示例">代码示例</h3>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>程序沿用进退法和黄金分割法作一维搜索。与上一篇相比，这里不需要第二个初始点，也不需要平行搜索；每次迭代只做三件事：沿当前方向一维搜索、算新点的梯度、用梯度模的比值构造下一个方向。方向用满 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个以后，按第⑤步重置为负梯度方向。</p>
<p>核心的递推部分如下：</p>
<details open="">
<summary>C++代码示例（共轭方向递推）：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">        // 3. 构造新的共轭方向
        if ((k + 1) % n == 0) {
            // 已用满 n 个方向，重置为负梯度方向
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) s[i] = -g_new[i];
            cout &lt;&lt; "  k = n，重置 S = -grad f" &lt;&lt; endl;
        } else {
            double g2_old = 0.0;
            for (double v : g) g2_old += v * v;
            double beta = g2 / g2_old;
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) s[i] = -g_new[i] + beta * s[i];
            cout &lt;&lt; "  beta = " &lt;&lt; beta &lt;&lt; ", ";
            print_vec("S", s);
            cout &lt;&lt; endl;
        }
</code></pre>
</details>
<p>完整程序如下，目标函数、梯度、一维搜索和输出都在其中。</p>
<details>
<summary>C++代码实现（完整）：</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;vector&gt;
#include &lt;cmath&gt;
#include &lt;functional&gt;
#include &lt;iomanip&gt;
#include &lt;stdexcept&gt;
#include &lt;utility&gt;

using namespace std;

// 进退法求初始区间 (复用)
pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket_minimum(function&lt;double(double)&gt; func, double a0, double h) {
    const int MAX_ITER = 1e4;
    if (h &lt;= 0) throw invalid_argument("Step size h must be positive.");
    if (func(a0) &lt;= func(a0 + h)) {
        double x0 = a0 + h, x1 = a0;
        h *= 2;
        double x2 = x1 - h;
        int iter = 0;
        while (func(x2) &lt; func(x1)) {
            if (iter++ &gt; MAX_ITER) throw runtime_error("Max iterations exceeded");
            x0 = x1; x1 = x2; h *= 2; x2 = x1 - h;
        }
        return make_pair(x2, x0);
    } else {
        double x0 = a0;
        double x1 = a0 + h;
        h *= 2;
        double x2 = x1 + h;
        int iter = 0;
        while (func(x2) &lt; func(x1)) {
            if (iter++ &gt; MAX_ITER) throw runtime_error("Max iterations exceeded");
            x0 = x1; x1 = x2; h *= 2; x2 = x1 + h;
        }
        return make_pair(x0, x2);
    }
}

// 黄金分割法 (复用)
double golden_section(function&lt;double(double)&gt; func, double l, double r, double eps) {
    double a = l, b = r, aa, bb;
    while (b - a &gt; eps) {
        aa = b - 0.618 * (b - a);
        bb = a + 0.618 * (b - a);
        if (func(aa) &lt; func(bb)) b = bb;
        else a = aa;
    }
    return (a + b) / 2;
}

// 从点 x 出发，沿方向 s 作一维搜索
vector&lt;double&gt; line_search(
    function&lt;double(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; func,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; s,
    double eps
) {
    auto phi = [&amp;](double alpha) {
        vector&lt;double&gt; y(x.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) y[i] = x[i] + alpha * s[i];
        return func(y);
    };

    pair&lt;double, double&gt; bracket;
    try { bracket = bracket_minimum(phi, 0.0, 0.1); }
    catch (...) { bracket = make_pair(0.0, 10.0); }

    double alpha_star = golden_section(phi, bracket.first, bracket.second, eps);

    vector&lt;double&gt; y(x.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; x.size(); ++i) y[i] = x[i] + alpha_star * s[i];
    return y;
}

// 输出一个向量
void print_vec(const char* name, const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; v) {
    cout &lt;&lt; name &lt;&lt; " = [";
    for (size_t i = 0; i &lt; v.size(); ++i) cout &lt;&lt; v[i] &lt;&lt; (i == v.size() - 1 ? "" : ", ");
    cout &lt;&lt; "]^T";
}

// 共轭梯度法：f 为目标函数，grad 为梯度函数，x0 为初始点
vector&lt;double&gt; conjugate_gradient(
    function&lt;double(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; f,
    function&lt;vector&lt;double&gt;(const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp;)&gt; grad,
    const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x0,
    double eps
) {
    int n = x0.size();
    vector&lt;double&gt; x = x0;
    vector&lt;double&gt; g = grad(x);

    // S^(0) = -grad f(X^(0))
    vector&lt;double&gt; s(n);
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) s[i] = -g[i];

    for (int k = 0; k &lt; 1000; ++k) {
        // 1. 沿 S^(k) 作一维搜索，得到 X^(k+1)
        x = line_search(f, x, s, eps);
        vector&lt;double&gt; g_new = grad(x);

        double g2 = 0.0;
        for (double v : g_new) g2 += v * v;
        double norm_g = sqrt(g2);

        cout &lt;&lt; "第 " &lt;&lt; k + 1 &lt;&lt; " 次搜索: ";
        print_vec("X", x);
        cout &lt;&lt; ", ||grad f|| = " &lt;&lt; norm_g &lt;&lt; endl;

        // 2. 收敛判断
        if (norm_g &lt; eps) {
            cout &lt;&lt; "  满足 ||grad f|| &lt; " &lt;&lt; eps &lt;&lt; "，停止迭代" &lt;&lt; endl;
            break;
        }

        // 3. 构造新的共轭方向
        if ((k + 1) % n == 0) {
            // 已用满 n 个方向，重置为负梯度方向
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) s[i] = -g_new[i];
            cout &lt;&lt; "  k = n，重置 S = -grad f" &lt;&lt; endl;
        } else {
            double g2_old = 0.0;
            for (double v : g) g2_old += v * v;
            double beta = g2 / g2_old;
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) s[i] = -g_new[i] + beta * s[i];
            cout &lt;&lt; "  beta = " &lt;&lt; beta &lt;&lt; ", ";
            print_vec("S", s);
            cout &lt;&lt; endl;
        }

        g = g_new;
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    cout &lt;&lt; fixed &lt;&lt; setprecision(6);
    cout &lt;&lt; "共轭梯度法求解二元二次函数极小值" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "目标函数: f(X) = x1^2 + 2*x2^2 - 4*x1 - 2*x1*x2" &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "理论最优解: X* = [4.0, 2.0]^T, f(X*) = -8.0" &lt;&lt; endl &lt;&lt; endl;

    auto f = [](const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x) {
        return x[0] * x[0] + 2 * x[1] * x[1] - 4 * x[0] - 2 * x[0] * x[1];
    };
    auto grad = [](const vector&lt;double&gt;&amp; x) {
        return vector&lt;double&gt;{2 * x[0] - 2 * x[1] - 4, 4 * x[1] - 2 * x[0]};
    };

    vector&lt;double&gt; x0 = {1.0, 1.0};
    double eps = 0.01;

    vector&lt;double&gt; result = conjugate_gradient(f, grad, x0, eps);

    cout &lt;&lt; "\n最终结果:" &lt;&lt; endl;
    print_vec("最优解 X*", result);
    cout &lt;&lt; endl;
    cout &lt;&lt; "目标函数值 f(X*) = " &lt;&lt; f(result) &lt;&lt; endl;

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>程序的实测过程如下：第一次搜索得到 <span class="math inline">\((2.001808, 0.499096)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f\| = 2.240126\)</span>，算得 <span class="math inline">\(\beta^{(0)} = 0.250908\)</span>，方向为 <span class="math inline">\([1.998208, 1.505417]^T\)</span>；第二次搜索得到 <span class="math inline">\((3.990933, 1.997670)\)</span>，此时 <span class="math inline">\(\|\nabla f\| = 0.016100\)</span>，还没有达到 <span class="math inline">\(0.01\)</span> 的精度，而两个方向已经用完，于是按第⑤步重置为负梯度方向，再搜一次，得到 <span class="math inline">\(X^* = (3.993963, 1.995688)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(f = -7.999978\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>手算两步就到 <span class="math inline">\((4,2)\)</span>，是因为一维搜索取了精确的极小点；程序用黄金分割法，精度 <span class="math inline">\(0.01\)</span>，所以第二步停在 <span class="math inline">\((3.990933, 1.997670)\)</span>，与理论值相差约 <span class="math inline">\(0.009\)</span>，最后的误差就来自这里。</p>
<h3 id="方法分析">方法分析</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>只需要梯度</strong>：每步作一次一维搜索、算一次梯度，不形成也不求逆 Hessian矩阵。存储量就是几个 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 维向量，与最速下降法相同，比牛顿法省得多。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong><span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 步收敛</strong>：对 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 元正定二次函数，只要一维搜索是精确的，<span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个共轭方向用完就能到达极小点。这是共轭方向的性质在梯度构造下的体现。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>是对最速下降法的改进</strong>：第一步与最速下降法相同，以后每步把负梯度偏转一个角度，避免相邻方向正交造成的锯齿，所以又称旋转梯度法。方向一次比一次“有效”，不像坐标轮换法那样沿固定的坐标轴方向反复搜索。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>与共轭方向法的区别在构造方式</strong>：平行搜索每构造一个方向要作两次一维搜索，还要另选一个初始点；共轭梯度法用梯度递推，一次搜索就前进一个方向，代价是要能计算梯度。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>共轭性依赖一维搜索的精度</strong>：一维搜索不精确，方向的共轭性就只是近似的，<span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 步收敛也不再严格。非二次函数的情形更是如此，所以算法保留了第⑤步的重置：用满 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个方向就重新从负梯度出发，重新积累共轭方向。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="总结">总结</h3>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>共轭梯度法把上一篇的“构造共轭方向”换了一个做法：不再用两次平行搜索去凑，而是用相邻两点的梯度差把 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 消掉，直接在负梯度上作修正。方向仍然关于 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span> 共轭，二次函数仍然 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 步收敛，但每一步只需要一次一维搜索和一次梯度计算。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\qquad\)</span>它的代价也很清楚：必须能算梯度。下一篇介绍<strong>鲍威尔法</strong>，它回到只用函数值的路子上，用平行搜索加方向替换来组织共轭方向，不需要梯度，也不需要 <span class="math inline">\(H\)</span>，是直接搜索法里很有代表性的一种。</p>
<hr>
<blockquote>
<p>本学习笔记参考资料：</p>

<p>[2] 武汉理工大学《最优化技术B》课程课件，授课教师：<a href="https://stle.whut.edu.cn/xygk/szdw/jgml/202108/t20210823_849715.shtml" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">颜彬</a>老师</p>
